description: How to verify a visual exit criterion for dexel: render the REAL running app (build the Go binary, run it with the fake provider, screenshot the page with headless Chromium per the feature-build-and-verify recipe), then judge the image — yourself if you have vision, and/or via scripts/visual-check.py's vision model. Use whenever an exit criterion describes something a human must SEE (a progress bar moving, a HUD element appearing, a character animating, art looking finished), or when a log records a visual check as unverified.

should_not_trigger: TODO: a nearby request that must NOT invoke visual-verification (e.g. one belonging to another dev-companion skill)
